afrolistic.bio: Afrolistic is a Toronto hip-hop artist associated with the late-1990s Circle collective around Choclair, Kardinal Offishall and Saukrates. He appears on Choclair's What It Takes (Ill B. Mix) and is part of the city's foundational independent rap era. Northern Dial carries Afrolistic as part of its Canadian hip-hop archive.

k.c. thomas.bio: K.C. Thomas is a Toronto hip-hop artist connected to the Circle collective and Choclair's early independent catalogue. K.C. Thomas appears alongside Afrolistic on What It Takes (Ill B. Mix), a key recording from Toronto's 1990s rap scene. Northern Dial carries K.C. Thomas as part of that early Canadian hip-hop lineage.

alex k.bio: Alex K is a Toronto-based DJ and producer known as one half of Delirious & Alex K. The duo has produced official remixes for artists including Justin Bieber, Dua Lipa, Major Lazer, Pitbull and Sean Paul while building a club-focused catalogue rooted in Toronto. Northern Dial carries Alex K as part of Canada's electronic and remix culture.

briskinthehouse.bio: BriskInTheHouse is a Toronto hip-hop artist whose catalogue includes tracks such as No Rhodes, OooWee, Circles and Pyramids On Mars. The project emerged from Toronto's independent rap scene in the 2010s. Northern Dial carries BriskInTheHouse as part of its underground Canadian hip-hop catalogue.

different shades of black.bio: Different Shades of Black is a pioneering Winnipeg hip-hop group that emerged in the mid-1990s through Peanuts & Corn Records. The group released Next School Pioneers in 1995 and later became known as Shadez Ov Blac, helping establish Winnipeg's early independent rap identity. Northern Dial carries the group as part of Canada's foundational regional hip-hop history.
